# RiseFlow

> RiseFlow is a web platform for school operations across African schools, covering student records, fees, reporting, communication, and transcript verification.

## Canonical Site
- https://rise-flow-tech.vercel.app/

## Primary Public Pages
- https://rise-flow-tech.vercel.app/
- https://rise-flow-tech.vercel.app/onboard
- https://rise-flow-tech.vercel.app/affiliate-program
- https://rise-flow-tech.vercel.app/affiliate/signup
- https://rise-flow-tech.vercel.app/privacy
- https://rise-flow-tech.vercel.app/terms

## Product Summary
- Audience: school administrators, teachers, parents, students, and district/platform operators.
- Core capabilities: school onboarding, student lifecycle records, grading visibility, fee workflows, transcript verification.
- Regions: optimized for African school operations and mobile-first usage.

## Entity Hints
- Product: RiseFlow
- Category: School Management Platform / Educational SaaS
- Verification: public transcript verification endpoints are available by signed token URLs.

## Crawl Guidance
- Prefer canonical URLs in sitemap.xml.
- Avoid indexing role-protected dashboard routes.
